changelog:
Initial release of the seo-firecrawl skill, providing comprehensive site crawling, mapping, and scraping for SEO analysis.

- Supports full-site crawling, site structure mapping, single-page JS-rendered scraping, and on-site search, all via Firecrawl MCP server.
- Integrates with seo audit, technical, content, schema, and sitemap skills for enhanced multi-agent workflows.
- Provides commands for deep or targeted crawls, broken link detection, content inventory, and crawl budget analysis.
- Includes instructions to check Firecrawl MCP tool availability and handle common errors or missing extension gracefully.
- Offers clear credit usage details and recommendations for fallback analysis when Firecrawl is not installed.
summary: Full-site crawling, scraping, and site mapping via Firecrawl MCP. Use when user says "crawl site", "map site", "full crawl", "find all pages", "broken links", "site structure", "discover pages", "JS rendering", or needs site-wide analysis.
